tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// thugs rje'i zla ba rgyas pa'i bzhin ras las// mkhyen rab ri dwags sgeg mo'i zur mig gis// bsil ldan sems can sa mos tshal gyi grogs// gzhar yang mi gtong bla ma spyan ras gzigs// 'phags pas rjes bzung grub dbang dpal mo zhes// bden pa'i rgyud mangs blo ldan yangs kyi rnar// shin tu snyan pa las brgyud smyung bar gnas// 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyong la de rmad byung*// tshul 'dir gong ma'i zhal lung nyin mor byed// rgyas shing byin rlabs drod du 'bar na yang*// blo dman mig gis mi bzod bzlog pa'i slad// nyams len snying po btus pa'i dkyil 'khor brdar// de la 'dir dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs smyung gnas kyi cho ga nyams su len pa la/ dus khyad par can rab sa ga zla ba/ de min yang zla ba gang yang rung ba'i dkar nag phyogs kyi tshes bdun nam bcu bzhi'i nam gseng snga bar gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su bcu gcig zhal gyi sku sogs dkon mchog gi rten bshams pa'i mdun du/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa ba byung dang dris byugs pa'i steng du/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dkar po/ shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang*/ mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon dang lha lnga'i mtshan ma can du bris/ phyi rol nas nyer spyod rnams gru bzhir bsham/ gtor ma gsum mam gnyis/ bum pa chu dang nang rdzas kyis bkang ba kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang sta gon bya'o// cho ga la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum/ dang po la gnyis las/ dang po gso sbyong blang ba ni/ blang ba'i yul bla ma yin na des 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/ theg pa chen po'i lugs kyi gso sbyong gi cho ga rang gis brjod pas gso sbyong blangs/ de nas slob dpon gdan la 'khod/ slob ma rnams kyis phyag gsum byas te mdun du 'khod pa la sngon 'gro phan yon dang brda sprod rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la/

slob dpon rang gis ji ltar blangs pa bzhin slob ma rnams rjes zlos byar gzhug cing 'bogs pas khyab/ de thob nas phyis rten gyi drung nas rang gis len pa ni/ thog mar khrus byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung spyi ltar bya/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa de rnams dang rten dbyer med par mngon sum bzhin bzhugs par dmigs la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag btsal la/ dad pa dang nges 'byung byams brtse byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslangs te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas thal mo sbyar la/ gso sbyong cho ga rang gi blo nas sam/ tha na'ang grogs shig gi lad mor byas nas len dgos te/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun du sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de rnams kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lhag par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sdom pa blangs la/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*// gzhan gyi nor ni blang mi bya// 'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*// brdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o// skyon ni mang po mnyam bsten pa'i// chang ni yongs su spang bar bya// khri stan mthon po mi bya zhing*// de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas// dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan// gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya// ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni// srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa// de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang*// bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs 'jig rten rnams// srid pa'i mtsho las 'don par shog /ces lan gsum dang*/ oṃ a mo gha shī la sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud+dha satwa/ pad+ma bi bhū ṣi ta bhū dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a wa lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*// tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan// rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /ces smon lam gdab/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ 'og nas bsang sbyangs zhes par sngags de gnyis shes par bya'o// stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

de bzhin du puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā dang*/ oṃ s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā zhes brjod/ skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs tshogs zhing spyan drangs la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs sh+lau ka dang*/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag byas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ gang yang bdag gi dus kun du// sdig par gyur pa gang bgyis pa// skrag pas rmi 'drar 'chags bgyid cing*// deng nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid// dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo// de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing*// skyabs gsum la ni bdag skyabs mchi// zhes lan gsum gyis bdun rnam dag byas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/

de nas oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ gis chos thams cad rnam par dag par bsam/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gis de thams cad stong pa nyid du bsams te de dag ni tshogs bsags pa'o// dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ dang po bdag bskyed pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus de nyid la zhugs pas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba hrīḥyig gis mtshan par gyur/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bkug nas sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa/ sku dang rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma gsum dbus ljang*/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng ma gsum dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ de'i steng khro zhal nag po/ de'i steng zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor can/ phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ gnyis pa gnyis phreng ba dang pad+ma/ gsum pa gnyis mchog sbyin dang spyi blugs/ bzhi pa gnyis 'khor lo dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis thams cad mchog sbyin mdzad pa'i mthil na spyan re re yod pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ras bzang po'i sham thabs dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar pad zla la gnas pa'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ po tā la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs la/ gong ltar mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/

slar yang hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la mchod/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas yum bzhi bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa byon nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan par bsam/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrīḥdakar po/ de las thugs rje chen po'i sku dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsam mo// bsgom pas skyo na spro bsdu'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin bya zhing*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya dzñā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na/ byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha te bh+yaḥ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭ+ṭe baṭ+ṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma ba re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dz+wa la ma pa na ye swā hā zhes gzungs ring tshar gcig gis sna drangs pa'i snying po ci nus bzla/ snying po ni/ tad+ya thā/ dha ra dha ra man chad yin no// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes yi ge drug pa'ang ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ thugs rje chen pos bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/

bdag bskyed rkyang pa nyams su len na skyabs 'gro nas 'di'i bar gyis chog go /gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs la/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas bh+rūm̐ dkar po zhig chad/ de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ rin po che'i khrir pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus su hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa sogs nas/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar brjod/ shar du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po/ lhor trām̐ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/ nub tu am̐ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ byang du aḥlas don yod grub pa ljang gu rnams rang rang gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o// rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drang ba nas/ dbang bskur ba'i bar gong ltar las/ bdag la zhes pa'i tshab tu 'di rnams la zhes dang*/ rgyas gdab kyi tshe/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ sangs rgyas rigs bzhi la rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ de nas thal mo sbyar te/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs nas/ rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin no// mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ke te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'dir maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa phul la/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun sogs nas/ skyabs gsum gnas la bdag skyabs mchi zhes pa'i bar gyi yan lag bdun pa bya'o// de nas bum pa bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis gang bar gyur/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la/ gzungs brgya rtsa dang*/ yi ge drug pa ci mang bzla'o// gsum pa mjug gi bya ba ni/ dza hi bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar thim zhes brjod shes shing nus pas spyi bor pad zla la gnas pa'i dge slong ma dpal mos ngo chen mdzad de bstod par bsams la/ po bstod lan nyer gcig gis bstod/ la/ mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod/ dus gsum bde bar sogs dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs sh+lau ka res bstod/ 'phags mchog thugs rjes bdag gzhan gyi// las ngan sdig sgrib kun sbyangs nas// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes 'dod don gsol ba btab bo// gtor ma 'bul ba ni chu gtsang gis bran la gsum ga bsang sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byas/ gtor ma dang po nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā lan gsum gyis phul/ 'phags mchog thugs rjes bdag gzhan gyi sogs sngar bzhin brjod/ gnyis pa oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāt+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā lan gsum gyis bsngos/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bstan srung dam tshig can rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten khams su bde legs 'byung ba dang*/ chos sgrub pa rnams kyi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing bsam don lhun grub kyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/

gsum pa'am sngar gyi lhag ma a kā ro dang*/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di gzhi bdag gnas bdag gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// 'jig rten khams su bde legs 'byung ba sogs gong ltar phrin las bcol lo// khrus gsol ba ni/ me long la lha'i gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ 'gro ba'i sgron me spyan ras gzigs mgon la// dri zhim bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis khrus gsol bas// 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis dri ma kun bsal nas// dri bral sku gsum brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes pas khrus gsol/ chu de slar bum par blugs la/ rang dang sgrub grogs rnams la bkye zhing*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes lan gsum bzlas pa dang*/ 'phags pa gtso 'khor gsum pa zhig mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te/ yi ge drug ma'i phyag nas bdud rtsi bab pa bdag gi spyi bo nas thim par bsam zhing khrus bya/ de'ang ma ṇi dang pos nyon sgrib dang*/ gnyis pas shes sgrib dang*/ gsum pas chos sku thob nas gtso 'khor gsum rang gi spyi bo nas thim par bsam zhing bum chu 'thung*/ de nas thal mo sbyar nas/ bdag gis nyes pa bgyis pa mtha' dag thugs rje chen po khyed la bzod par gsol gyis/ bdag la sgrib par mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ lan bdun brjod la/ ye shes pa mdun gyi rten la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hās brtan bzhugs bya'o// de'ang cho ga zhag sbrel nas byed pa'am rkyang khug gnyis la/ rdul tshon gyi lha mi gshegs par brtan bzhugs bya/ tshes bcu drug lta bu grol ba'i skya rengs nas gso sbyong ma gtogs pa'i cho ga tshar gcig gtang rag gi tshul du byas nas/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod cing rdul tshon bsdu/

gnyis ka ltar yang bdag bskyed kyi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim pas rang nyid thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med par yang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /nyin mor bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs par// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ces pa'i bsngo ba smon lam dang shis pa brjod do// de lta bu'i tshul gyis sa ga la sogs pa'i tshes bdun nam bcu bzhi lta bu la smyung gnas rkyang pa/ brgyad dam bco lnga la khug pa/ dgu'am bcu drug la rjes chog ste/ rkyang khug gnyis ka la cho ga tshar gsum re byed rkyang pa'i nyin dkar gsum la brten pa'i zas gdan gcig bya/ ngag bcad mi byed kyang ngag 'khyal spang*/ khug pa'i nyin ngag bcad shin tu dam par byed/ mid pa rgyun bcad de gnas par bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis smyung bar gnas par bgyis na/ bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba phyir bsnyil ba sogs dang*/ skye ba dman pa bud med kyis kyang smyung bar gnas pa lan gcig byas pa na/ shi nas byang chub sems dpa' skyes pa'i lus thob nas/ 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni rgyud kyi steng nas rtogs par 'gyur ro// smras pa/ dpal mgrin lta byed las ni spros pa'i mes// me tog gzhu can rags lus yongs bsregs pa// su zhig smyung bar gnas pa lan res kyang*// bskal par bsags pa'i sdig ltung 'jig par mtshon// rnam dag legs bshad mang pos brjod bya'i bzhin// rnam gsal cho ga'i me long bskrun pa'i dges// rnam mang 'gro la phan pa kun bsgrub cing*// rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig

/ces smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gsar rnying chos kyi spyan ras rnam par yangs pa bla ma bsod nams lhun grub pa nas gzhan la phan pa'i dgongs pas nye bar bskul ltar/ lugs 'dir tshad mar gyur pa'i mkhas pa mang pos mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi brjod bya bsdus nas nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa bi dza yan+tu/ maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang dpal mo'i zhabs// paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu ye shes bzang*// bal po pe nya zla ba rgyal mtshan dang*// grub thob nyin phug pa la gsol ba 'debs// spru pa rdor rgyal zhang ston dgra 'jigs dang*// mkhan chen rtsi 'dul bde ba can pa dang*// byang sems chu bzang shes rab 'bum pa dang*// rgyal sras chos rje rnams la= /bud+dha shrī dang rje btsun kun dga' bzang*// rgyal tshab dam pa yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// dkon mchog lhun grub paṇa chen brang ti pa// dpal ldan don grub rnams la= /shes rab 'byung gnas mkhas btsun kun dga' legs// sangs rgyas phun tshogs

tshul khrims lhun grub zhabs/ bkra shis dbang phyug zhabs// tshul 'dir bka' drin rmad byung bla ma sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la= /yang na kun dga' bzang po'i rjes su/ mus chen dkon rgyal shākya don grub dang*// stong rwa kun legs kun dga' chos grags zhabs// kun dga' rnam rgyal rnams la= /mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang dang bco brgyad pa// ngag dbang lhun grub rmor chen lhun grub mtshan// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen bla ma sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la= /bla ma rnams dang lhag pa'i lha mchog gi /mkhyen brtse nus pa chen pos legs gzigs nas// nam 'chi nges med rtogs pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// dka' spyad chos la nus par byin gyis rlobs// dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs 'gro zhing*// 'gro ba srid las gdon pa'i blo gros kyis// byang chub 'grub pa'i rgyu tshogs zab rgya che// bdag gi rgyud la myur du rdzogs bgyid shog /bcu gcig zhal mnga' stong gi spyan ras kyis// gzigs pa rab gsal phyag stong ldan pa'i sku// snang stong chu zla lta bur legs bsgoms pas// 'bras bu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku thob shog /bklags pa tsam nas bsod nams dpag yas rgyun// 'jo ba'i gsang sngags zab mo 'phags pa'i gsung*// grag stong brag ca'i dbyangs 'drar rab bzlas pas// yan lag drug cu'i gsung mchog thob par shog /spros rtog mtshan ma kun gyis rab dben yang*// chos kun gzigs pa lhun grub 'phags pa'i thugs// rig stong dbyer med mkha' 'drar mnyam bzhag pas// thams cad gzigs pa'i ye shes thob par shog /bsnyen sogs rnam par dag byas las kyi tshogs// rab 'byams 'gro ba'i don du legs bsgrubs pas// mthar thug gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis// sems can kun gyi bsam pa rdzogs byed shog /de ma thob kyi skye nas skye ba'i phreng*// dal 'byor rten ldan dam pas rjes bzung nas// zab dang rgya che'i chos la longs spyod cing*// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i phrin las sgrub par shog

/dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// zhes sogs brjod de/ de ltar thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lam 'di la mos pa'i rnal 'byor pa bla mkhyen bsod nams rgyal gyi gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
